_about: Wall-panel wall spec. Geometry rules and numbers for ONE wall; everything the generators and the LayOut set need that is not a rule. mm, wall-local: x along the wall from its left end as seen from the room, z up from finished floor, y = 0 at the wall face, negative toward the room.

build_up._face: frame 19 + gap 3.3 + panel 22 (spec v5). The model's frames are 3/4 in = 19.05; the face is kept at 44.3 as built (probe 596).

panels._max_width: ASSUMED, not a recorded decision: one MDF sheet width. REC-LAU's columns come out the same for any value from 1061 to 1266. Override per segment with columns[].

row_seam._: horizontal joint along the top of the door leaf cladding (handoff 2026-10-07: the door is one of the grid's panels)

panels._numbering: [number, column, row] as on TM Italia order 260318 (Ares set). Leave numbering out for a new wall and the generator numbers column by column, lower row first, from 1.

rebate._: panels passing in front of the door frame lose their rear 10 mm inside x0+2.5 .. x1-2.5, z < h (probe 538)

openings.handing: Right-handed, opens into Laundry, concealed hinges, soft-close

openings._panel_overlap: panel edges P14 / P16 run 55 mm into the opening (TM layout; Q9 - TBD until the glass door is measured)
openings.label: WINE ROOM (GLASS DOOR INSTALLED)

subframe._strip: 4 in strip = 98 (12 per sheet width, 1/8 in cutter); 6 in = 152 (proposal 2026-10-07)

clips._: 543: centre 75 from panel edges, rows <= 600 apart, 3 columns on a panel wider than 900; 564: a column over a stile moves onto the stile centre, but never closer than 40 to the panel edge
clips._row_over_opening: LEGACY, kept so REC-LAU regenerates its issued drilling: the bottom row over an opening sits at 2555.8, the centre of the OLD frames' rail (562). The rule for a new wall is the centre of the bottom rail over the opening (2554 here) - leave this key out.

questions: Door D01 must be flush with the wall panels. Our build-up: backing frame 19 + clip gap 3.3 (Fastmount VL-03H, recess mount) + panel 22 = finished face 44.3 mm from wall. Please confirm a jamb depth of 201.8 mm on a 170 mm wall, and send the revised hinge/stop detail.

Opening per UCON survey is 995 x 2505 mm (your drawing: 989 x 2451). Please build D01 to our opening with your technical gaps: head 9, sides 4.3, floor 0 -> frame 986.3 x 2496, leaf cladding 884 x 2404, 10 mm to finished floor. Please confirm.
Right-handed, opens into Laundry, concealed hinges, soft-close. Please send hinge make, model and specification.
Your section shows the leaf body and hinge block down to 0 mm at the floor; only the cladding has a 5 mm gap. What is the actual clearance of the leaf body? Is there a threshold or seal?
Door cladding thickness: the current profile shows 12 mm, an older table showed 25 mm. Please confirm 12 mm.

Panels are hung on Fastmount VL-03H clips, recess mount, gap 3.3. Please make the clip recesses in the panel backs at the factory per sheets D-01..D-04 (D25 x 7 deep). Please confirm which clip half goes into the panel (we assume male) and that you can drill per the schedule.
Wall height per UCON survey is 3112 mm (your drawing: 3052). Panel rows are laid out to 3112.
Wine room glass door is installed; final measurement pending. Panel edges P14/P16 at the opening and bottom of P11/P12 are TBD until then.

All drilling coordinates are given from the panel BACK: X from the left edge as seen from the back, Z from the bottom edge. A control column gives X from the face. Please confirm before drilling - mirrored drilling is the main risk.
